# P-003 - Full local-scope closure
<!-- phase: P-003 -->

<!-- section: P-003.objective -->
<a id="p-003-objective"></a>
## objective
Verify the complete approved local package and close its operational documentation.
<!-- /section: P-003.objective -->

<!-- section: P-003.scope -->
<a id="p-003-scope"></a>
## scope
Deliver OPERATIONS.md and resolve every in-scope gap, preserving tested behavior. Requirements: G-001, R-ID, R-NOTE, R-OPS. No expansion into a deployed service.
<!-- /section: P-003.scope -->

<!-- section: P-003.contracts -->
<a id="p-003-contracts"></a>
## contracts
Re-read all canonical requirements. Reuse P-001 and P-002 exports. Distinguish intended contracts from actually implemented evidence; detect any drift before closure.
<!-- /section: P-003.contracts -->

<!-- section: P-003.implementation -->
<a id="p-003-implementation"></a>
## implementation
Implementer documents runtime setup, transient storage, supported errors and the exact full test command. Tester adds documentation checks and executes the complete positive/negative suite. Reviewer maps all requirements without introducing an unsupported production claim.
<!-- /section: P-003.implementation -->

<!-- section: P-003.verification -->
<a id="p-003-verification"></a>
## verification
Run the complete declared all-tests gate and inspect package/source inventory for secrets, unused dependencies, placeholders and unintended network calls. Record inspection findings with paths; automated tests do not prove all semantic properties.
<!-- /section: P-003.verification -->

<!-- section: P-003.acceptance -->
<a id="p-003-acceptance"></a>
## acceptance
Every project requirement has implementation, tests and reviewed evidence. Documentation states the in-memory limitation. No P0/P1 finding remains; final TODO is checked only after independent gates and closure.
<!-- /section: P-003.acceptance -->

<!-- section: P-003.handover -->
<a id="p-003-handover"></a>
## handover
Publish the final evidence index, source snapshot, full requirement map and local-operation instructions. This is educational fixture closure, not proof of a live host deployment.
<!-- /section: P-003.handover -->

## Cross-phase reference
The reader includes the generated exact-source context. Reference does not import another phase's implementation tasks.
